name: cyclin dependent kinase inhibitor 1A
pathways: positive regulation of protein kinase activity

function.text: CDKN1A encodes cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein sequestering activity and molecular function activator activity. It participates in positive regulation of protein kinase activity and Ras protein signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma; Hepatocellular Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
